liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Franklin's Tower** (2 reviews): Considered the most inspired Franklin's Tower so far in the band's history; Jerry's guitar work is nice, and the Franklin's Tower performance was smooth [9][14]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Listeners are advised not to sleep on the Tennessee Jed performance [17]
- **Lazy Lightning** (1 review): Lazy Lightning appears mid-second set, part of a mixed rotation of tunes [16]
- **Drums** (1 review): The drums are immense and clean, with a complex snare pattern [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-06-17.163393.aud.unknown.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 174 min [1]. Said about its sound: Level fluctuations occur in the first few minutes of Cold Rain & Snow [1]
- **gd1976-06-17.sbd.miller.80739.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 197 min; rated 4.62/5 by 8 [3]. Said about its sound: Keith's vocals are prominent in the mix rather than buried, with good playing; The show has great sound, with vocals described as particularly sweet [6][16]
- **gd1976-06-17.mtx.seamons.91861.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 198 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: The matrix mixdown is described as clean, crisp, and well balanced; Hunter Seamons spliced sources into a matrix that makes the show breathe; Described as the sweetest recording on the site, with the band rocking hard [7][8][13][14]
- **gd1976-06-17.helpslipfranks.mtx.seamons.123027.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 3 songs; 25 min [5]

## Around the show

- The crowd and the reviewer loved the entire performance [9]
- The performance is compared to the Boston Music Hall show as very solid [6]
- Cited as one of the best 1976 shows, with great sound and sweet vocals [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-06-17.163393.aud.unknown.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes (unknown mics/deck); Bob Wagner's 1st generation cassettes [1]
- **gd1976-06-17.sbd.miller.80739.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) D [3]. Also: All disc changes in the recording are seamless [3]
- **gd1976-06-17.mtx.seamons.91861.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: MATRIX MIX: SBD/AUD (About 60%/40%) [4]. Also: Charlie Miller handled transfers and mastering; Hunter Seamons created the matrix; The show is seamless, though some cuts existed in the original AUD source [4]
- **gd1976-06-17.helpslipfranks.mtx.seamons.123027.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Partial 3 song Matrix by Hunter Seamons; Soundboard recording by Betty Cantor-Jackson; Audience recording transferred by Dale Shepherd; note: The seeder's… [5]
